cheatSignalsIntro: Automated rules surface patterns for staff review. A signal is investigative context and never applies a sanction.
multiAccountsIntro: These clusters show accounts sharing a hashed IP, network range or network/browser pattern in the last 30 days. Groups start at two accounts and are review context only. Shared networks and browsers are common in households, schools, workplaces, VPNs, and mobile carriers; overlap alone does not establish shared ownership or abuse.
noClusters: No shared network, range or browser patterns with two or more accounts were found.
rangeWeakerEvidence: A shared network range is weaker evidence than a shared address: mobile carriers, carrier-grade NAT, campuses and large VPN exits put many unrelated players in the same range. Treat it as context only.

kindHelp.SIGN_IN: A successful sign-in from this network/browser.
kindHelp.SIGN_UP: An account created from this network/browser.
kindHelp.SEEN: A recorded day of activity (at most one per day) without a sign-in.

signalUpdated: The signal status was updated. No account sanction was applied.
actionFailed: Could not update the signal. Try again.
loadFailed: Could not load abuse signals. Check your access or try again.
signalsIntro: Admin-only detection signals: shared networks, resource funnelling, bot-like timing and fresh-account farming. A signal is context for staff review. It applies no ban or penalty and players never see it. Thresholds are in System settings under “Abuse detection”.
filterPlayerHelp: Filed on, related to or linked
reviewNoteOptional: Optional. Recorded in the audit log for the next reviewer.
dismissNoteRequired: Required. Say why this is fine; it is recorded in the audit log and keeps the signal from reappearing for 30 days.
noPenaltyNote: This only changes the signal. No account sanction is applied.
stateChanged: Another reviewer already changed this signal. Reload and check its state.

reasons.shared-network: Accounts share a hashed network address
reasons.shared-network-browser: Accounts share a network and browser pattern
reasons.funnel-ratio: Sources send most of their output to one account
reasons.shared-login-pattern: Some accounts also share a login network or browser
reasons.gold-ping-pong: Gold goes back and forth in both directions
reasons.always-on: Active in nearly every hour of the day
reasons.fresh-account-attacks: A new account was attacked and beaten repeatedly

chatShadow.title: Chat shadow moderation
chatShadow.intro: A decision model reads recent chat messages in the background and records what our policy would do. Nothing is hidden, deleted or sanctioned; this page only measures whether the policy is right.
chatShadow.empty: No verdicts yet. Turn on "Shadow chat moderation" in Server settings to start recording.
